name: Lantern_Keeper
negative_prompt: photorealistic, live action, anime, flat 2D, text, letters, watermark, logo, blurry, low quality, deformed hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, duplicate characters, inconsistent character design
style_prompt: Gritty 3D animated dark fantasy comedy, stylized exaggerated characters, cinematic volumetric lighting, deep forest greens, amber firelight, film grain, vignette, highly detailed

characters.name: Keeper
characters.description: a skinny young bald monk with big innocent eyes, a brown hooded robe and a rope belt, carrying a small lantern

characters.name: Bartender
characters.description: a massive moss-green troll bartender with a prominent underbite, cracked tusks, a braided beard full of beer caps, a black leather vest and studded wristbands

characters.name: Guitarist
characters.description: a lean red-skinned troll guitarist with long greasy black hair, a black leather vest and a bone-and-oak electric guitar

scenes.name: Forest arrival
scenes.prompt: an ancient dark forest at night, twisted roots and glowing fireflies, the monk walking alone along a twisting path
scenes.motion_prompt: the monk walks forward cautiously, lantern swinging, fireflies drifting around him
scenes.end_prompt: the monk pauses at the edge of the clearing, lifting the lantern to inspect the tavern lights

scenes.name: Tavern reveal
scenes.prompt: the monk pushes giant ferns aside and discovers a tavern built inside a colossal hollow tree, glowing amber windows and a smoking chimney
scenes.motion_prompt: the monk pushes the ferns aside and steps into the clearing as the tavern is revealed
scenes.end_prompt: the monk stands clear of the ferns, gazing up at the fully revealed tavern

scenes.name: First mug
scenes.prompt: inside the warm smoky tavern, the troll bartender slides a giant mug of golden beer toward the tiny monk at a barrel table
scenes.motion_prompt: the bartender slides the mug forward while the monk leans in with wide eyes
scenes.end_prompt: the mug rests in front of the monk, who reaches toward it as the bartender smiles

scenes.name: Guitar solo
scenes.prompt: the red-skinned troll guitarist leans back and shreds a bone-and-oak guitar on a stage made of skulls and barrels, sparks flying
scenes.motion_prompt: the guitarist leans back, hair whipping, fingers flying over the fretboard
scenes.end_prompt: the guitarist finishes the solo with the guitar raised and sparks bursting around the stage

scenes.name: Moonlit forest
scenes.prompt: wide shot of the colossal hollow-tree tavern glowing in the dark forest under a giant full moon, fireflies swirling
scenes.end_prompt: the fireflies sweep around the tavern windows beneath the moon
